text:
alice.k: ACME support escalated — embeddings calls intermittently failing with "dimension mismatch" and large p99 latency (~12s). Started ~09:15UTC. They report retries, and some customers see vector length 1536 while others 768. Full thread follows.

ben.infra: can you paste the exact error? also which model id they requested?

alice.k: error from their app logs: `Embedding vector length 1536 but model expects 768`
Request payload (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ***
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
{
  "model": "text-embedding-3-small",
  "input": ["...doc text..."]
}
```
They insist they set `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` header.

caitlin.ml: hmm `text-embedding-3-small` should produce 1536, right? wait which variant uses 768? older internal `embedding-lite` was 768. Could be falling back to a legacy model in another pool.

dave.sre: routing-bot logs show a few hundred requests in the spike being routed to `embeddings-us-west-2-fallback` pool between 09:14:30 and 09:18:00 due to capacity saturation in eu pools. That fallback has an older compiled variant that outputs 768 dim vectors.

route-bot: [routing trace] trace_id=rt-9b2c: request 1933337777 -> candidate pools: eu-west-1-primary (full), eu-west-1-burst (full), us-west-2-fallback (selected), model_variant=embedding-lite-legacy(768)

alice.k: ohhh. So the dimension mismatch is from cross-pool fallback selecting legacy variant. Customer app isn't set up to handle 768. They get an error when validating vector shape client-side.

eva.am: Customer upset, asking for SLA credit + explanation. They sent a perf report showing lots of timeouts and many retries increasing their bill.

ben.infra: immediate mitigation: we can force-routing for that customer to `eu-west-1-dedicated` if they have Dedicated enabled, or temporarily enable `pin_region` on their tenant to block fallback to us-west. I've run a patch to prefer eu-burst with queuing rather than cross-region fallback — rolling to 3 hosts now.

caitlin.ml: long-term we need two things: (1) ensure fallback pools expose compatible model variants (same embedding dim) or do transparent rescaling/translation, (2) pre-warm common embedding variants in fallback pools to avoid cold starts causing us to pick older compiled builds.

alice.k: repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate saturated eu pool by setting small capacity token
export RW_TEST_OVERCAP=1
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":["hello"]}'
```
I saw routing to us-west and got dim=768 in response. Attached server-side router trace: `route_id=rt-9b2c`.

ben.infra: thanks, that's great repro. I dug into the autoscaler logs — eu-west-1-primary exhausted by a large batch job (partner bulk embed). Our scale-up lag was ~45s so requests spilled. Fallback logic intentionally prioritizes throughput over model parity. That's the current risk.

dave.sre: action items (short-term):
- pin customer to eu region (support action)
- credit billing for duplicate retries (billing team)
- rollback fallback behavior to queue in-region for embeddings for next 30m (we'll push config)

route-bot: deploy 1933337789: routing-policy change -> prefer-queue-in-region for embeddings rolled to 50% of routers.

deploy-bot: ⚙️ deploy 1933337789 finished (canary).

ben.infra: deployed. Early metrics: eu queue latency +200ms but no parity mismatches observed in canary. I'll continue ramping.

caitlin.ml: mid-term: update fallback pools to carry matching compiled model variants and add unit test to assert dim equality on fallback selection. Also add a compatibility-check in router: if selected target model.dim != requested_model.dim, prefer queueing or transform.

eva.am: I've told ACME we'll pin them and issue a billing credit for the retry burst. They've accepted the temporary pin. They'll want a postmortem and confirmation the region pinning doesn't impact throughput.

alice.k: assigning follow-ups: BEN (routing config + monitor ramp), CAITLIN (compat check + regression test), DAVE (billing ticket + PM follow-up). I'll open a support incident and add transcript.

ben.infra: note — this also affected a handful of other tenants in eu (small %). I'll publish a short postmortem once the rollback fully ramps.

alice.k: thanks all. Customer confirmed service restored and vectors now consistently 1536. Closing urgent escalation but keeping open for the compatibility patch. :thumbsup:

route-bot: [monitor] eu-west-1 embeddings spillover events dropped to 0 after policy change.

alice.k: filing incident ticket: INC-2026-7890 with timeline, repro, and billing credit assigned.

caitlin.ml: adding a note: also consider marking embedding shape in the API response header `X-Embedding-Dim: 1536` to make client-side validation clearer and enable auto-retry/translate logic.

alice.k: good idea. I'll add that to the follow-up doc.

end of thread.
